data.name: Isle of Man
data.summary: Self-governing Crown Dependency outside the UK and EU. No capital gains tax, no inheritance or gift tax, no wealth tax. Income, including dividends, is taxed at 10%/21%; residents can fix their total income tax at £220,000 a year (£440,000 per couple) for 5 or 10 years.

regimes.name: Ordinary Isle of Man residence
regimes.description: Resident individuals pay income tax at 10% and 21% on worldwide income. No capital gains, inheritance, gift or wealth tax.
regimes.eligibility: Tax residence in the Isle of Man (see residency test). Living there requires a right of abode / immigration permission for non-British, non-Irish nationals.

capital_gains.summary: The Isle of Man has no capital gains tax. Gains by a resident private investor on listed shares, bonds, a private business or real estate are not taxed. Gains that amount to trading (frequent dealing, property development) are taxed as income at up to 21%.

open_questions: The PwC 'other taxes' page does not state 'no CGT' in terms; confirm with the Income Tax Division's own statement if precision on land-development profits is needed.
capital_gains.rate_basis: No capital gains tax exists. PwC lists income tax as the only tax on income ('There are no other taxes on income'); capital gains are outside the income tax charge unless they are trading profits.
capital_gains.professional_trader: Profits from a trade in shares or land (badges of trade: frequency, financing, intention) are income taxed at 10%/21%. A buy-and-hold family portfolio is not normally a trade.

dividends.summary: Dividends are taxed as ordinary income: 10% on the first £6,500 of taxable income (single), 21% above. A large dividend income is therefore taxed at 21% (personal allowance £17,000 is withdrawn above £100,000). Residents can elect a tax cap of £220,000 a year (see special regime).
dividends.exemptions_thresholds: Personal allowance £17,000 single / £34,000 jointly assessed, reduced by £1 per £2 of income above £100,000 / £200,000. 10% band £6,500 / £13,000.

open_questions: Credit relief mechanics (unilateral relief for non-treaty source countries) and exact treaty count not verified from an official list.
dividends.rate_basis: Top marginal income tax rate 21% for 2026/27 (gov.im rates table). Manx companies are mostly taxed at 0%, so there is no imputation credit on domestic dividends.
dividends.withholding_outbound: No withholding tax on dividends paid by Isle of Man companies (PwC).
dividends.treaty_network: Small network of double tax agreements (UK, Guernsey, Jersey and a handful of others); no income tax treaty with the United States, so US-source dividends suffer 30% US withholding. Relief for foreign withholding tax is by credit against Manx tax.

wealth_tax.summary: No wealth tax or net worth tax.

sources.title: Isle of Man - Individual - Other taxes

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Local rates (property tax) are charged on occupied property; amounts are modest and not a wealth tax.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance tax, estate duty or gift tax. Only a court probate fee on Isle of Man assets is payable, capped at £9,422.50 for estates over £1 million (2024 schedule).
inheritance.exemptions_thresholds: Probate court fee on the gross value of Isle of Man estate only: £31.50 up to £10,000 rising to a flat £9,422.50 above £1,000,000 (fees as at 2024). Negligible relative to a large estate, hence 0.

inheritance.foreign_assets: No tax on foreign assets; foreign assets are not counted for the probate fee.
inheritance.domicile_rules: No domicile or residence test applies because there is no tax. A family arriving from the UK should check the UK's residence-based inheritance tax (from 6 April 2025: long-term UK residents remain within UK IHT for up to 10 years after leaving).

regimes.name: Income tax cap election
regimes.description: A resident individual may elect to cap total Isle of Man income tax at £220,000 a year (£440,000 for a jointly assessed couple) for 2026/27 elections. The cap amount in the first year applies for the whole 5- or 10-year election period, and it is payable each year even if normal tax would have been lower.
regimes.eligibility: Must be, or be about to become, Isle of Man tax resident. Election in writing with details of wealth and income, approved by the Assessor; new residents must elect within 60 days of starting residence. Fixed period of 5 or 10 consecutive tax years, renewable.
regimes.duration_note: Each election fixes the cap for 5 or 10 consecutive tax years (Income Tax Division guidance note GN51) and can be renewed by a further election, with no limit on renewals, so the cap is available for as long as the person stays resident. It ends if the person leaves or does not renew; the cap amount is fixed at the first-year figure for each election period.

lump_sum.notes: £220,000 single / £440,000 jointly assessed couple (2026/27). Payable each year of the 5- or 10-year election regardless of actual income (GN51 s3.2). Capital gains are untaxed anyway. Renewable, so treated as indefinite.

dividends.summary: Under the cap, the whole income tax bill is fixed at £220,000 (single) or £440,000 (couple) a year, so additional dividends carry no extra Manx tax once ordinary tax at 21% would exceed the cap (roughly £1.05m of taxable income for a single person).

residency.tax_residency_test: No statutory definition; the Assessor decides on the facts. Individuals arriving with the intention of establishing residence are generally resident from arrival (PwC). Day-count guidance from the Income Tax Division was not verified here.

routes.name: British/Irish citizens (Common Travel Area)
routes.requirements: British and Irish citizens can live in the Isle of Man without permission; work permits may still apply to some employment.

routes.name: Isle of Man Tier 1 (Investor) or other immigration permission
routes.requirements: Non-British, non-Irish nationals (including EU citizens since Brexit) need immigration permission under Isle of Man immigration rules, which broadly follow the UK system. Routes and thresholds were not verified in this research.

corporate.summary: Standard corporate income tax rate 0%. 10% applies to deposit-taking banking and to retail profits above £500,000; 20% applies to Isle of Man land and property income. No withholding tax on dividends. Economic substance rules apply to relevant activities.

Single-year count of a very small number; the 2024-25 report records none. Same definition as UNODC intentional homicides per 100,000.

data.us_citizen_notes: No US-Isle of Man income tax treaty, so no treaty relief and no saving-clause issues; US federal tax applies on worldwide income with credit for Manx income tax paid. The fixed tax-cap payment may be creditable only to the extent it is an income tax on the year's income.
